According to the QS World University Rankings by Subject 2022, the University of Cape Town (UCT) does not specifically offer a financial engineering program. However, UCT's Finance and Accounting Department is ranked number 101-125 globally.

If we consider universities in South Africa that have financial engineering programs, the University of Pretoria (UP) does offer a BSc (Eng) in Financial Engineering which is accredited by the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA). As of now, the University of Pretoria is not ranked in the QS World University Rankings by Subject for Financial Engineering because the program is relatively new and not yet established enough to receive a global ranking.

To learn more about the University of Cape Town and its other offerings, visit https://www.uct.ac.za/. For more information on the University of Pretoria's financial engineering program, visit https://www.up.ac.za/eng-fund/engineering-programmes/financial-engineering.

It's always a good idea to consult the university websites or contact the institutions directly to find the most accurate and up-to-date information on their programs and rankings.

As for the University of Pretoria (UP), it was not listed in the QS World University Rankings by Subject for Financial Engineering. However, UP was ranked 151-200 for Mathematics.

These rankings can change from year to year, so it is recommended to refer to the QS World University Rankings by Subject for the most current information. The University of Cape Town (UCT) is widely recognized for its excellence in various academic fields, including financial engineering. According to QS World University Rankings by Subject, UCT has been ranked as the top university in Africa for business and management studies, which includes financial engineering. 

For the most recent rankings, UCT's financial engineering program was ranked in the top 100 worldwide by QS for the subject of Business and Management Studies. Specifically, in 2021, UCT was ranked 75th globally in this category. 

In terms of a direct comparison with the University of Pretoria (UP), UP has also shown strengths in business and management studies, but UCT generally performs better in global rankings, particularly within Africa. Please note that rankings can fluctuate from year to year, so it's a good idea to check the latest available rankings for the most up-to-date information.

Keep in mind that program quality can also be measured in other ways besides rankings, such as faculty reputation, research output, industry connections, and the practical experience students gain. It's always a good idea to research each program thoroughly, including reaching out to current students and faculty for their insights. 

For the latest and most specific information, visiting the official websites of both the University of Cape Town and the University of Pretoria, and consulting QS World University Rankings or other reputable sources, would be the best practice. 

Remember, rankings can be a starting point but should not be the sole determining factor when choosing a university or program.
